scope: Sequential, alternating order, Windows release AOT and synthetic target/input.
No physical probe/SWD, phone network, OS pipe or display presentation proof.
CPU chart recording excludes raster; calibrated-block P95 is not frame latency.
Short runs do not prove long-run timing or stable 10 kHz.
